# AI Tools + Resources for Newsrooms

> Practical guides, templates, and reference materials for journalists building tools with AI coding assistants. Created by Joe Amditis at the Center for Cooperative Media, Montclair State University.

## Overview

- URL: https://tools.amditis.tech
- Author: Joe Amditis, Center for Cooperative Media
- Version: AI Tools Kit v2.6
- Audience: Journalists and newsroom staff learning to build with AI

## Guides

- Vibe coding guide: https://tools.amditis.tech/vibe-coding/ — Core methodology for shipping AI-assisted code, from zero to deployed project
- Terminal setup: https://tools.amditis.tech/terminal-setup/ — Configuration guide for Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Codex
- Quick reference card: https://tools.amditis.tech/quick-reference-card/ — Printable one-page cheat sheet for AI coding commands
- Language guide: https://tools.amditis.tech/language-guide/ — Python vs JavaScript vs R recommendations for journalists
- Technical glossary: https://tools.amditis.tech/glossary/ — 40+ plain-language definitions of AI and coding terms
- LLM selection guide: https://tools.amditis.tech/llm-advisor/ — Decision matrices for choosing the right AI coding assistant
- Tool stacks: https://tools.amditis.tech/tool-stacks/ — Free and low-cost development resources for newsrooms
- Code patterns: https://tools.amditis.tech/code-patterns/ — Seven reusable Claude Code approaches for common journalism tasks
- Next level: https://tools.amditis.tech/next-level/ — Strategy guide for moving from AI sessions to AI systems: autonomy, memory, review stacks, verification

## Browser extensions

Chrome and Edge extensions built by Joe Amditis. Each installs from the Chrome Web Store and works in both Chrome and Edge, since Edge adds Chrome Web Store extensions directly.

- LinkSweepr: https://tools.amditis.tech/linksweepr/ — Keeps the domains you choose out of your browsing history, automatically and on-device. Local-only, no network requests.
- SocialSnag: https://tools.amditis.tech/socialsnag/ — Right-click to download full-resolution images and videos from Instagram, Twitter/X, Facebook, and Bluesky.
- PocketLink: https://tools.amditis.tech/pocketlink/ — Turns the current page into a Bit.ly shortlink and copies it to your clipboard in one click.

## Downloadable templates

- CLAUDE-RULES templates for 12 project types (web apps, data pipelines, editorial tools, etc.)
- LESSONS templates for project retrospectives
- Vibe coding checklist (Markdown)
- LLM comparison chart (Markdown)
- Changelog template (Markdown)

## Key concepts

"Vibe coding" is the practice of using AI coding assistants (like Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or Codex) to build software by describing what you want in plain language. The AI writes the code, and you guide the process through iterative prompting. This approach makes software development accessible to journalists and other non-programmers.

## About the author

Joe Amditis is a journalist and technologist at the Center for Cooperative Media at Montclair State University. He builds tools and resources to help newsrooms adopt AI and collaborative journalism practices.
